text: At its meeting on November 13 and 14, 2024, City Council considered Item CC23.4, entitled "Appointment of Public Members to the CreateTO Board of Directors" and appointed two public members to the CreateTO Board for the following terms: · Marni Dicker for a term of office starting on November 15, 2024 and ending on November 30, 2025; and · Mark Bonham for a term of office starting on November 15, 2024 and ending on March 28, 2028. City Council also appointed Allison Mendes as Chair of the CreateTO Board starting on November 15, 2024. All members are appointed at the pleasure of Council and serve until successors are appointed. These appointments are the result of the end of Marni Dicker and Dennis Fotinos’ initial terms of office, which ended on October 2, 2024, as well as the resignation of the former Chair, Ron Carinci, on November 4, 2024.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO received the item for information.
